# hosted-entity-signing

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/hosted-entity-signing.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `hosted-entity-signing` component of `libs/openid-federation`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.authority`: generated from its catalogue, [hosted-entity-signing.json](../../libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/hosted-entity-signing.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_OPENBAO_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `HOSTING`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_OPENBAO_URL` (system property `oidf.openbao.url`, then env `OIDF_OPENBAO_URL`); superseded, still read: `OPENBAO_ADDR`; superseded, still read: `BAO_ADDR`; superseded, still read: `VAULT_ADDR` | Unset | OpenBao's address, for hosted agents' signing keys (one transit key each) and the attester's; unset, the first of OPENBAO_ADDR, BAO_ADDR and VAULT_ADDR that is set | **Per request**: Missing or wrong: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500 | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN` (system property `oidf.openbao.token`, then env `OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN`); superseded, still read: `OPENBAO_TOKEN`; superseded, still read: `BAO_TOKEN`; superseded, still read: `VAULT_TOKEN` | Unset; a secret, never shown | The OpenBao token for the same; unset, the first of OPENBAO_TOKEN, BAO_TOKEN and VAULT_TOKEN that is set | **Per request**: Missing or refused: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500 | Any | Yes |
